verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop tools can plausibly offer virtual or extended displays, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows viewing and controlling existing remote screens, such as choosing between two detected monitors, and never shows a tablet or spare device acting as an extra display that extends the desktop. Missing for 10: any documented extended or virtual display mode, and any evidence of a tablet used as a second monitor.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
